project_context.description: Executive Analytics Command Center for MPCA (Madhya Pradesh Cricket Association) ERP. Hybrid of Data-first Analytics and Sports-broadcast HUD. Isolated under /design-preview/* routes.
project_context.emotional_tone: Authoritative, live, technical, broadcast-native, data-dense, command-center.

rules: Use Bebas Neue (uppercase) for all big numeric hero counters (KPIs, Scores).
Use IBM Plex Sans for standard labels, body text, and tooltips.
Use IBM Plex Mono for tabular data, timestamps, and small financial figures.
Strictly NO rounded soft fonts. Use sharp tracking and aggressive weights for headings.

visual_enhancers.cards: Sharp-edged (rounded-none). Absolutely NO rounded-lg or rounded-md. Borders must be 1px solid #1E293B.
visual_enhancers.live_indicators: Pulsing dots (bg-crimson or bg-pitch_green with animate-ping) next to 'Live' or 'Active' states to mimic broadcast graphics.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use dark stadium lights backgrounds for the main landing page. Keep inner dashboard panels matte and flat to prevent data obfuscation.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid soft glassmorphism. Use semi-transparent dark blocks (bg-surface/90) with sharp borders if overlapping is necessary.

component_patterns.hero_counters: Large Bebas Neue numbers (text-5xl to text-6xl) in saffron or cyan, accompanied by small all-caps mono labels with wide tracking (tracking-widest).
component_patterns.ticker_strip: Use react-fast-marquee. Deep background (bg-black), bright mono text. Separate items with discrete separators like ' /// ' or a solid square block.
component_patterns.kanban_board: Sharp columns with deep navy backgrounds (bg-[#0A1118]), 1px border. Cards within have left-border colored based on status.
component_patterns.hud_panels: Broadcast style panels with header strips (bg-surface_elevated) containing a mono title, followed by dense data or ECharts instances below.

grids_and_layouts.bento_density: High density grids (Data-first Analytics). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Tight padding inside cards (p-4 or p-6) to maximize data density. Keep outer margins generous.

motion.page_load: Staggered fade-ins and subtle slide-ups using framer-motion (staggerChildren: 0.05, y: 10, duration: 0.3).
motion.hover_states: Slight scale (scale: 1.01) and border color change (border-cyan_hud). No heavy soft box-shadows; rely on sharp border highlights.
motion.live_elements: CSS animate-ping for live dots. Smooth continuous scroll for tickers.

echarts_config_guidance.general: Dark theme configured by default. backgroundColor: 'transparent', textStyle: { fontFamily: 'IBM Plex Sans', color: '#94A3B8' }, tooltip: { backgroundColor: '#111A24', borderColor: '#334155', textStyle: { color: '#F8FAFC' } }
echarts_config_guidance.sankey: Used for Financial flow and Officials workload. Nodes: sharp rectangles (itemStyle: { borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#FFF' }), Links: gradient opacity (lineStyle: { color: 'gradient', curveness: 0.5 }).
echarts_config_guidance.treemap: Used for Budget Heads. Deep hierarchy. Use dark borders between blocks (itemStyle: { borderColor: '#0A1118', borderWidth: 2 }).
echarts_config_guidance.calendar_heatmap: Used for Match density. Color range from #1A2634 (low) to #2A9D8F (high) to #FF8A00 (very high). Split by months.
echarts_config_guidance.radar: Used for Division Scorecard. Sharp angular polygons. No smooth curves. Area styled with low opacity and high border width.
echarts_config_guidance.gauge: Used for Budget Utilisation. Broadcast speedometer style. Split into distinct color segments (green, yellow, red).

page_blueprints.name: Design Proposal Landing
page_blueprints.layout: Grid of 8 sharp-edged cards (image background with heavy dark overlay bg-black/80). Prominent banner at top: 'DESIGN PROPOSAL v1 - Stakeholder Preview Only'.
page_blueprints.elements: Cards should have big numbers (01-08) and crisp descriptions.

page_blueprints.name: Season Overview / Home Command Centre
page_blueprints.layout: Top row: Live match ticker. Second row: Hero KPIs (Tournaments, Matches, active claims). Third row: Toss countdowns, quick drill-downs.
page_blueprints.elements: Pulse dots for active matches. Bebas Neue hero numbers.

page_blueprints.name: Grant Claims Lifecycle Board
page_blueprints.layout: Kanban board layout. 6 columns representing states (Draft -> Docs Pending -> Submitted -> Under Review -> Approved -> Payment Made).
page_blueprints.elements: Mini waterfall chart and ageing distribution histogram in a side panel or top summary row.

page_blueprints.name: Unified Budget Health
page_blueprints.layout: Left wide panel: Treemap of budget heads. Right panels: Actual-vs-budget gauges, top-5 overrun heads (horizontal bars), invoice velocity sparkline.

page_blueprints.name: Tournament Calendar & Performance
page_blueprints.layout: Top full-width: Annual calendar heatmap. Bottom split: Tournament Gantt chart and format-mix donut.
page_blueprints.elements: ECharts Calendar and custom Gantt view.

page_blueprints.name: Match Officials & Squads
page_blueprints.layout: Top half: Officials workload Sankey diagram. Bottom half: Squad-selection funnel per format and fitness radar.
page_blueprints.elements: Dense ECharts integration. Tooltips are critical here.

page_blueprints.name: Financial Flow
page_blueprints.layout: Hero full-width: Big Sankey diagram (BCCI -> MPCA -> Divisions -> Districts -> Clubs). Bottom: Monthly cash-flow area chart and treasurer's outflow ticker.
page_blueprints.elements: Sankey is the focal point. Use distinct vibrant colors for different entities.

page_blueprints.name: Compliance / Wiring Status
page_blueprints.layout: Main component: 8 tournament types × 10 wiring steps compliance heatmap. Right sidebar: Red-flag alerts and 'days-since-last-audit' list.
page_blueprints.elements: ECharts heatmap. Use crimson for red-flags and pitch green for compliant.

page_blueprints.name: Division Scorecard
page_blueprints.layout: Left: Comparative ranking list (10 divisions) with horizontal bar rows. Right: Radar chart overlaying top 3 divisions for comparison.

stadium_background.description: Cricket stadium lights at night. Use as a heavy overlay background for the command center landing page to establish the broadcast feel.

texture.description: Abstract dark green texture for specific HUD panel background accents (e.g., live matches).

instructions_to_main_agent.dependencies: yarn add echarts echarts-for-react react-fast-marquee @phosphor-icons/react lucide-react framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Create all routes strictly under /design-preview/*. Do not alter existing routes.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_fetching: Mock realistic sample data client-side for these preview pages. Label as 'sample data' in tooltips to indicate this is a design demo.
instructions_to_main_agent.tailwind_config: Extend colors with the specific MPCA HUD palette (e.g., mpca-navy: '#0A1118', mpca-surface: '#111A24', mpca-saffron: '#FF8A00', mpca-crimson: '#E63946', mpca-pitch: '#2A9D8F') in tailwind.config.js.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case role-based (e.g., data-testid='kpi-card-matches').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do NOT make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep borders sharp for this specific dashboard.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or dropdowns over content.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Do not use default rounded-lg. This design requires decisive angular language (rounded-none).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
